evals.prompt: A team member keeps suggesting we add a dark mode. It's not in scope for this quarter. Park it so it stops coming up without losing the idea.
evals.expected_output: Records the idea with the reason it is set aside and the trigger that would make it worth revisiting, placed where it will be seen.
expectations: States the idea and why it is not being done now
Records it with enough context to be understood later
Names the trigger that would make it worth revisiting
Places it where it will be seen when the trigger fires
Confirms the idea was heard and recorded, not dropped

evals.prompt: Park the request to support Safari 14. Our analytics show 0.2% of users on it, and the work is significant.
evals.expected_output: Records the request with the reason and the revisit trigger, and does not make it the parker's responsibility to remember.
expectations: Records the request with the reason it is set aside
Does not authorize starting the work
Does not make the idea the parker's responsibility to remember
